source: SEL-C0 clean-train 2032 candidate records and the same exact lattices
anchor: clean-lineage V8 fallback, candidate rank 0; chosen using the 1421-query selector-training fold only
actions: STAY plus unique projected orders from V13 ranks 1 through 10; ranks 5 through 10 reported separately
candidate_value: exact-cache oracle legal monotone stop contract, never H0 predictions
strong_repair: no loss at any attainable anchor or Complete, and a gain at an attainable anchor or Complete
strong_token_saving: same attainable-anchor success vector and Complete=true for both, with lower oracle legal cumulative multi-anchor tokens
break: any previously successful attainable anchor or Complete becomes false
other: no_gain or mixed/undefined cost; no strong positive label
stability: flag observed G0A threshold flips when their mask is on a candidate trajectory; no new Target calls
evaluation_role: train-only descriptive opportunity audit; prior C1 611 fold is design-exposed and is not a clean gate
